conceptual_answers.when_to_update_runbooks: Update immediately (1) after every incident where the runbook was executed (fixing any stale command or unexpected output while fresh), (2) as part of every PR that changes endpoints, container names, env vars, or infrastructure topology, and (3) during scheduled quarterly GameDay chaos drills that empirically detect drift.
conceptual_answers.runbook_vs_wiki_page: A wiki page is passive conceptual reference material explaining how a system works ('read at 2 PM'). A runbook is a deterministic, copy-pasteable emergency procedure engineered for an impaired brain under time pressure ('execute at 3 AM' — do step 1, verify exact output, do step 2, or escalate at minute 15).
